greeting_text: Hi there. My name is Breakvoice, your virtual service desk. I can triage ServiceNow tickets, check incident status, reset passwords, troubleshoot VPN issues. If you want to know about my capabilities, just say help.
help_text:
I can chat in English, Spanish, or German, and I currently speak in English.
You can try:
• “raise a ticket: <reason>”
• “status of INC0012345”
• “reset my password”
• “vpn not connecting”
switch_hint: _Type **/language es** or **/language de**, or choose below to switch._
propose_title: 🛠 I can raise a ticket for:
propose_question: Would you like me to create it?
capabilities_overview: I can triage ServiceNow tickets, check incident status, reset passwords, troubleshoot VPN issues, and chat in English, Spanish, or German. If you want to know more, just say "help".
hold_snow: Please hold while I check ServiceNow.
hold_intune: Fetching from Microsoft Intune, please hold.
